articles.summary: CLEVELAND, Oct. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Avient Corporation (NYSE: AVNT), an innovator of materials solutions, intends to release its third quarter 2026 earnings before the market opens on Wednesday, November 4, 2026. The company will then host a webcast with a slide presentation at 8:00 a.m.
articles.title: Avient to Hold Third Quarter 2026 Conference Call

articles.summary: CLEVELAND, Oct. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Board of Directors of Avient Corporation (NYSE: AVNT), an innovator of materials solutions, has declared a quarterly cash dividend of twenty-eight and a quarter cents ($0.2825) per share on the common stock outstanding, representing the sixteenth consecutive annual increase.
articles.title: Avient Announces Sixteenth Consecutive Annual Dividend Increase
